notes:
What's new in 0.1.119:
- Watching in the browser: pressing Pause now holds the "Up next" countdown, so a paused film no longer jumps to the next episode; it carries on after Play. The player now remembers your audio and subtitle language correctly (a remembered German choice could pick a Georgian track, and remembered Spanish subtitles could fail to come back).
- Download copies and subtitles: the smaller download copies (1080p and 720p) now keep the film's built-in text subtitles, and a downloaded film can offer its saved subtitle files to the phone app. Picture-style subtitles are still left out.
- Discover and Watchlist: the lists are now kept for each person and checked against what that person may see, and a late answer after a refusal no longer leaves the wrong list showing. Photos keeps the album and the status line in step when you switch album or filter.
- Sign-in and sharing: personal API keys now stop working at once when the account's sign-ins are revoked (for example after "sign out everywhere"). A removed member's late radio and podcast work no longer writes for them. The web page of Family viewing no longer keeps the mode on past its idle time-out. A guest or member whose upload failed while filing can retry it.
- Beebo Relay and Trip Journal: every Beebo Relay failure now gives a plain reason, and a passing fault is tried again automatically. Sharing a trip again asks for the new link first and turns the lost one off only after that, and Cancel always ends the job.
- Library: a (converted) copy hides its original only when no other original with the same name exists, folders that differ only in letter case no longer hide each other on disks that tell them apart (not tested yet: needs such a disk), and posters from the movie database are published only when they are whole.
- Watch Together: guests are told in words when the host is away, changes or ends the room, and the host-change notice clears by itself. Jellyfin apps: 18 app calls that used to get Beebo's sign-in web page now get a proper answer, a playback report with no position keeps the saved resume point, and a compilation's performer links open the performer.
- Smaller fixes: the update prompt and the bell panel keep keyboard focus, Kitchen announcements recover quietly after a failed refresh, "Not now" on the first-run away prompt is remembered, more screens are translated, and the export check that your export file is not one of your own protected files now compares exact file identity.
- Automated tests and code review only; this build has not been installed on a PC or tried on a TV, phone or Jellyfin app by a person yet. 0.1.118 was published on November 11, 2026. The phone app (1.61) and Beebo Auto (1.22) are separate releases published the same day.
